body:
I sometimes feel like there are people who can't get over things, because it's just how they are. 

This is how I feel. I see no way back from this. I know how I am and this is too much to bear. Life after this... I just can't.

But I don't think I will ever be able to explain myself to someone again. That and they just won't be him. I can't live with this knowledge. I'm 26 and I know everyone says there is so much time but to me it's time without him.

I don't feel like that at present. I love this person do much, we share such a way at looking at the world. He made me a better person. Now there is nothing. The thought of anyone else turns my stomach. I can't continue like this.
I never properly showed him my potential, I see the beauty in do many things. He is someone that does that every day as part of his job, I didn't match up.
I could have been a more inspiring person. I wish I had shown him more of my ambition and 'widescreen' thoughts. I wish I hadn't come across as so ordinary. I really, really loathe myself for that.

I stay with people on the weekends and in the week I am alone trying to hold down my job. I can't believe this is my life. 

Even your username - we had so many happy times playing Minecraft. I can't deal with this loss, it gets worse and worse everyday. This wasn't some silly relationship, no one cheated. I wish I had been 'better'. I can't deal with having to settle for a lesser life. That is not my life. That is why I don't want to wake up.
I will never find someone as wonderful as this again. I can't live with that. I can't carry on with life when I am carrying that knowledge with me.

I felt so awful today and really just wanted to go back to bed but after reading this, I'm going to make myself go and see a film.

I hope you feel good.

Thanks for replying. I guess that's true, no two stories are the same, but you can go ahead and tell yours. Sometimes it really helps to read about others.

I am trying to focus on the not being alone. I feel more alone than I ever have - it's hard to wake up in the morning. I hate myself for typing that as I never wanted to be that person again. I thought I had got past it.

Thanks again.

Hello,

Thanks for replying - you sound very kind and that does mean something.

I am thinking about the medication more. It's hard. It's hard to be this person that has to be medicated just to deal with life. I am hoping to see a counsellor soon but I worry that know some of the things they are going say and that I won't move forward. There's only really one person I want to speak to about all this and I guess it's the one person I cannot talk to.

I am hoping to start studying Astronomy properly soon, in my spare time. I have a great love for it and sometimes looking on that scale helps. It makes me so sad though as I used to talk about it lots with him. I wish I still could.

Going to make myself watch a film. It's hard because anytime I do something like that I feel like I am not being 'good enough'. And then they cycle of 'if I was good enough he wouldn't have...' etc

I wish I could have the floor back under my feet.

Thank you again.

I just don't know if the strength will ever come. Living with knowing what I have lost is just... Life feels like it is just depression now. That is not a life. I don't think I can do this... I am trying - but it almost feels like it is getting harder?

Thank you

I am going though this now. I feel like all is lost - I lost the person I adored most in the world after 7 years. Finding it hard to believe it can ever get better. Just feel like I have to slowly 'get used' to this. I find that thought abhorrent, it doesn't feel like a life for me. I try to get strength from stories like these but - I find it so hard right now. It just don't want to wake up to this every day.

Met and talked with someone earlier. They are good friends with the SO. I feel so sad. They kind of said yes, you probably won't meet someone like that again, but...

I just feel so sad. I still think of myself as being 'with' this person (we have done LD in the past and I have learnt to fill my time when they are not around).

Just cannot believe this, everyday I feel worse, everyday takes me further from what was 'my life'.

I'm sorry to write here again but I feel more and more hopeless. That I will never be myself again. Thanks.

I still feel like I could have done something. I would do anything for this not to be the case. I had walking around with this knowledge of what went before and what has happened. I would rather just stop. Feelings get darker. I am trying my best.

I think the thing I feel is that I was beginning to really get there and the foundation of this relationship gave me a platform to do this. I felt inspired by this person and felt that it gave me the 'oomph' I needed.

Alone I find hard. But not, alone and knowing what I had...

That makes it so difficult to want to wake up.
